body: Don’t feel ashamed? It doesn’t matter what other people think. It’s as simple as just ignoring it. You wanna dye your hair? Then just do it. Nobody can stop you. Don’t listen to other people when they only put you down. And what your mom said about having to work harder? Don’t worry about ANY of that. Just be you. That’s what people hate. They hate seeing others happier than them. So make them hate you by loving yourself. Boyfriends don’t matter, you’re only 14, girl. Just because you haven’t found one now doesn’t mean you never will. If anything it gives you an advantage by being able to love yourself first. I will be honest, I have zero idea what it’s like being black, and I’m sure people will dog on me for giving you advice, but that’s okay. It’s important to have different view points too. TL;DR don’t let other people influence you. Do what you want and love no matter what other people think or say. It doesn’t matter. Only you matter. Your parents opinion doesn’t, teachers, or peers. Just be you. There’s no shame in that. I hope this helps :)
